# Nehal Nadaf — Creative Portfolio

> Nehal Nadaf is a freelance web developer, UI/UX designer, video editor, and social media agency founder based in Hubli, Karnataka, India. He builds premium websites, produces cinematic brand videos, and runs influencer marketing campaigns for businesses across India and worldwide.

## Who is Nehal Nadaf?

Nehal Nadaf is a multi-disciplinary creative professional based in Hubli, Karnataka, India, with 5+ years of video editing experience delivering end-to-end digital work for businesses. He operates locally, remotely across India, and internationally.

He is the founder of a boutique creative agency in Hubli that provides web development, video production, social media management, and influencer marketing as a single cohesive offering.

## Services

### Web Development
- Custom websites and web applications using React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and GSAP
- All projects deployed on Vercel with sub-second load times, 90+ Lighthouse scores, and full SEO optimisation
- Serving small businesses, startups, and entrepreneurs across India and worldwide

### UI/UX Design
- Conversion-focused digital experiences with modern typography, micro-animations, and user-centred design
- Tools: Figma
- Available for international projects remotely

### Video Production & Editing
- Cinematic video editing and professional colour grading using DaVinci Resolve
- Specialities: brand films, Instagram Reels, YouTube content, product promos
- Clients include automotive detailing studios, restaurants, dental clinics, and educational institutions

### Social Media Management & Marketing
- Full-service social media content production, strategy, and management
- Instagram Reels production, branded graphics, YouTube video editing
- Serving brands in Hubli, Karnataka, and across India

### Influencer Marketing
- Connects brands with Instagram and YouTube content creators in Hubli, Karnataka, and across India
- Influencers average 50K–100K+ views per post
- End-to-end campaign management: strategy, creator matching, content review, performance tracking
